acceptanceCriteria: Linux reads runner identity from /proc/<pid> without a process listing.
A Linux-tagged test covers it; a benchmark records before/after.
body: Residual from lane perf-1022s (PR beamfall/corvint#1552, seal aaa260d44). PSR-V0-201 made Darwin pool runner identity a direct kernel query (3.53 ms to 10.9 us per call). Linux still uses the listing path.
title: Pool runner identity on Linux still lists processes; read it from /proc
